title: [Master] Nightacout crash caused a permanent local db corruption?
symptom: Nightscout client stopped receiving data, then AAPS stopped calculating anything; loop runs lasted minutes and no COB or IOB calculated. Restarts and reinstalls didn't help, only a DB reset did.
evidence_quote: A day later my aaps would not calculate anything anymore. A loop run was lasting minutes and no cob or iob would be calculated at all. Aaps restarts and reinstalls wouldnt solve the issue, only a DB reset did.
